name: Sit to stand
cue: Use a stable chair against a wall. Stand within a comfortable range and sit with control.
source: ICFSR sarcopenia guidelines; ACSM resistance training position stand

name: Hip hinge
cue: Keep your back comfortable and move from your hips. Use a small range.
source: ICFSR sarcopenia guidelines; ACSM resistance training position stand

name: Supported step up
cue: Use a stable low step and support. Keep the movement comfortable.
source: ICFSR sarcopenia guidelines; ACSM resistance training position stand

name: Band row
cue: Secure the band safely. Draw elbows back without shrugging.
source: ICFSR sarcopenia guidelines; ACSM resistance training position stand

name: Supported carry
cue: Keep a comfortable upright position and a clear path. Count controlled steps.
source: ACSM resistance training position stand; prototype exercise selection

name: Wall plank
cue: Breathe normally. Hold gently for the displayed seconds without straining.
source: ACSM resistance training position stand; prototype exercise selection

name: Supported balance
cue: Stay beside a stable chair. Use support throughout; never practice with eyes closed.
source: Otago Exercise Programme meta-analysis; Age and Ageing 2010
